Coram:

For the Petitioner : Ms.
Supriya Dayal, Advocate Mr. Anurag Kashyap, Advocate For the State : Mr. S.K. Tiwari, Special P.P.
Order No.03 / Dated :19.08.2023 Heard both the sides.

The petitioner- Raghunath Rakshit is in custody since 15.04.2023 in connection with Jamtara Cyber Crime P.S. Case No. 21 of 2023 for the offence registered under Sections 414, 419, 420, 467, 468,
471, 120B of the Indian Penal Code and Section 66(B), (C), (D) of Information Technology Act pending in the Court of learned Additional Sessions Judge 1st, Jamtara.

entities.text: Jamtara Cyber Crime P.S. Case No. 21 of 2023
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: As per the prosecution case, the petitioner was running CSP Centre and it is alleged that he in connivance with others, facilitated cyber frauds and transfer of the proceeds of crime obtained by cyber fraudsters.
On getting this information, the police conducted raid in which four mobile, two SIM cards, passbook and cheque book were seized from the CSP shop.
It is submitted by the learned counsel on behalf of petitioner that there is no material to connect this petitioner in cybercrime committed against any person.
The seizure does not connect the petitioner to the cyber offence.
It is submitted that the petitioner has one criminal antecedent in which he has been acquitted.
Learned Special P.P. opposed the prayer for bail.
It is submitted that suspicious e-wallets were found to be created by the SIM of the petitioner.
The petitioner has two criminal antecedents of offence of similar nature.

Considering the facts and circumstances of the case, the prayer for bail of the petitioner, is hereby,
rejected.
